Leftover Meat Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 11:32pm

Ingredients




Leftover beef or pork roast
1 pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
1 can Golden mushroom soup
Instant potatoes or leftover mashed potatoes





Preparation

1 Cook vegetables according to directions. Mix with leftover meat and soup. Place meat mixture in a casserole dish. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes to an hour.
